author: More Perfect Union
description:
Trump has a scheme to push junk health insurance plans on millions of Americans.

Under the “Great Healthcare Plan,” families could be the hook for up to $27,600 before coverage kicks in. Those who can’t keep up with costs are left taking out loans with insurers.

It’s a boon for corporate executive profits at patients’ expense.

Host: Conner Gibson
Producer: Victoria Hammett
Editor: Andrew Rivera
title: Health insurance CEO found a new way to exploit you
